description: Declarative local-first marketplace pack for capability cards, provenance ledgers, install review, trust rubrics, promotion gates, and blacklist policy.

workflow.description: Declarative install-review workflows for untrusted marketplace candidates.

ledger.description: Local provenance ledger contracts for reviewed marketplace content.

schema.description: JSON Schema assets for marketplace cards and review records.

optional_integrations.reason: Pack bundles and suite composition stay with the suite pack; marketplace records card-level review evidence.
Suspicious candidates, excessive permissions, and blacklist decisions route to security review.
Learned skills and durable knowledge records stay with memory/knowledge; marketplace records install and trust evidence.
Connector execution, secrets, and live grants stay with connector gateway; marketplace captures card metadata only.

overlap_notes.defaultspack: Owns active grants, pack selection, and runtime enforcement.
overlap_notes.rumi_pack_suite_pack: Owns bundle installation and suite composition; marketplace owns candidate card trust metadata.
overlap_notes.rumi_security_review_pack: Owns security analysis; marketplace owns triage, provenance, and blacklist policy.
overlap_notes.rumi_connector_gateway_pack: Owns connector execution; marketplace owns connector-card review records.
